title: KernelFoundry: Hardware-aware evolutionary GPU kernel optimization
abstract: Evolutionary framework for LLM-based GPU kernel optimization combining MAP-Elites quality-diversity search over kernel-specific behavioral dimensions, meta-prompt evolution, and template-based parameter optimization. Evaluated on KernelBench, robust-kbench and custom tasks with SYCL kernels; 2.3x average speedup on KernelBench.
